headline: A minute is plenty.
sub: Open it, say one thing about today, put the phone down.

headline: Just talk.
sub: Pause, laugh, lose your thread. It is listening.

headline: Every change is marked.
sub: Put any fix back with one tap. Nothing is added.

headline: A book that grows by month.
sub: Every letter is filed by your child's age.

headline: Said once. Heard for years.
sub: Read it, and hear the voice that said it.
